note: Wine Mono (.NET Framework) and Wine Gecko (MSHTML) for Debian sid wine 10.0~repack-12+b1. Versions and SHA-256 are the ones compiled into that build's appwiz.cpl (usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/wine/{i386,x86_64}-windows/appwiz.cpl of libwine_10.0~repack-12+b1_amd64.deb, pinned in wine-lock.json and signed by the Debian archive), so the trust chain is Debian's signature -> appwiz.cpl -> these files. Downloads only from dl.winehq.org. Licenses: Wine Mono is MIT/X11 + LGPL-2.1 components (Mono), Wine Gecko is MPL-2.0 (Firefox/Gecko).
